role: Internal implementation schema; no release authority

tracker_readback.response: Object with explicit majorDimension ROWS and quoted finite range 'Math Puzzles'!Afirst:Dlast
tracker_readback.target: first==last==canonical requested row, within authenticated rowCount
tracker_readback.full_scan: first1,last==authenticated rowCount; exact A:D columns. Returned values may omit trailing blank rows.
tracker_readback.matrix: List of row lists, <=covered row count, each row<=4 cells
tracker_readback.concurrency: Grid changes between properties and values may fail closed; recover read-only with fresh metadata.

tracker_evidence.before_scan: Pinned initial full response request/response pair for every receipt
tracker_evidence.properties: Pinned fresh post-attempt actual spreadsheet metadata
tracker_evidence.target_readback: Pinned exact row response against fresh properties
tracker_evidence.after_scan: Pinned final full response against fresh properties
tracker_evidence.append_count1: Before scan contains no problem/DOI, exact append result required
tracker_evidence.append_count0: reconciliation_before exactly equals before_scan; unique exact problem/DOI at target; no additional write

publication_preflight.tracker_scan: Exact request/response wrapper, validated with authenticated metadata, full grid/header/no problem
publication_preflight.pure_acceptance: publication_lineage reads and validates pinned preflight responses before accepting stage ancestry

binary_process_capture.save: save_process_streams writes raw stdout/output and stderr before strict UTF-8/JSON parse
binary_process_capture.exceptions: Available stdout/output and stderr retained before exception details/rethrow
binary_process_capture.fixtures: Historical string-returning adapters remain unchanged; NEW adapters implement binary contract

public_http.saved_payload: Exclusive file opened before reading; incremental binary chunks written and hashed
public_http.interrupted: Append IncompleteRead.partial after earlier chunks; flush and save READ_FAILURE type/size/hash/partial count; rethrow
public_http.oversize: Returned bytes already read are retained, then fail when above cleared size
public_http.recovery: Existing intents prohibit repeated mutation; known publication recovers read-only

remaining: Root resolution and NEW independent six-source audit required
